translation.src_text: Li te souvan, souvan bò kote mari l,
translation.tgt_text: Sanite Belair, the wife of Charles Belair, prepa­red the battle plans and participated in the deci­sions for the fight against the French soldiers.

src_text: Li te souvan, souvan bò kote mari l,

translation.src_text: se konsa, yo te arete toulède ansanm.
translation.tgt_text: She was often with her husband.

src_text: se konsa, yo te arete both ansanm.

translation.src_text: Solda franse yo te tòtire tou-lè-de anpil.
translation.tgt_text: They were arrested together.

src_text: "Solda franse yo te torture tou-lè-de anpil."

translation.src_text: Men Sanit te mete fanm sou li pou li pa moli devan blan yo ki t ap tòsyonnen li.
translation.tgt_text: The French soldiers tortured them wit­hout mercy.

src_text: Men Sanit te mete fanm sou li pou li pa moli devan blan yo ki t ap tòsyonnen li.

translation.src_text: Alòske yo te vle koupe tèt li kouwè yon vòlè oswa kouwè yon kriminèl,
translation.tgt_text: However, Sanite was a courageous woman in the face of the white torturers who kil­led her.

src_text: Alòske yo te vle koupe tèt li kouwè yon thief oswa kouwè yon kriminèl,

translation.src_text: li te batay ak sòlda franse yo ki te oblije fizye l.
translation.tgt_text: Wanted for decapitation as it was done for thieves and other criminals, she fought with the French soldiers, who in turn had to shoot her.

src_text: li te batay ak sòlda franse yo ki te oblije shoot l.

translation.src_text: Madan Pajo
translation.tgt_text: Madame Pajo

src_text: Madan Pajo

translation.src_text: Nan Ti Rivyè Latibonit, madan Pajo te sèvant kay Labe Vido,
translation.tgt_text: In Petite Rivière de l'Artibonite, Madame Pajo was a servant at Abbé Vido.

src_text: Nan Ti Rivyè Latibonit, madan Pajo te servant kay Labe Vido,

translation.src_text: se te abitid li rantre pami sòlda franse yo, pou li espyonnen yo.
translation.tgt_text: She used to spy on French soldiers.

src_text: se te abitid li rantre pami sòlda franse yo, pou li spy onnen yo.

translation.src_text: Se konsa, yon jou, alòske Desalin te vin rann Labe a vizit, Madan Pajo te aprann yo t ap vin arete Desalin,
translation.tgt_text: So one day, while Dessalines was visiting Abbé Vido, Madame Pajo learned that Des­ salines had to be arrested.

src_text: Se konsa, yon jou, alòske Desalin te vin rann Labe a visit, Madan Pajo te aprann yo t ap vin arete Desalin,

translation.src_text: li gentan kouri fè jeneral anchèf la siy la pou li vole gagè.
translation.tgt_text: Then, rushing forward, she ran towards the general-in-chief and signed to him to flee.

src_text: li gentan kouri fè jeneral anchèf la sign la pou li vole gagè.

translation.src_text: Viktorya Montou Viktorya Montou te gen yon ti non jwèt : Toya.
translation.tgt_text: Victoria Montou Victoria Montou had a nickname “Toya“.

src_text: Viktorya Montou Viktorya Montou te gen yon ti nickname jwèt : Toya.

translation.src_text: Li te esklav sou bitasyon Dekawo, kote limenm ak Desalin, ti neve li, yo te konn pase anpil mizè anba travay pi di ki genyen poutèt karaktè rebèl yo.
translation.tgt_text: She was a slave on the Decao dwelling, where she and her nephew Dessalines had endured a lot of suffe­ ring in hard work, because of their rebellious na­ ture.

src_text: Li te esklav sou bitasyon Dekawo, kote limenm ak Desalin, ti neve li, yo te konn pase anpil mizè anba travay pi di ki genyen poutèt rebellious karaktè yo.

translation.src_text: Paske yo toulède te gen yon lè ap konplote, yo separe yo :
translation.tgt_text: Because they seemed like they were always plotting, they were separated.

src_text: Paske yo toulède te gen yon lè ap konplote, yo separate yo :

translation.src_text: yo te deplase Toya pou voye li ale sou bitasyon Kolon Delije.
translation.tgt_text: Toya was sent to settler Delije's dwelling .

src_text: yo te deplase Toya pou voye li ale sou plantation Kolon Delije.

translation.src_text: Li te reskonsab yon gwoup esklav.
translation.tgt_text: She was in charge of a group of slaves.

src_text: Li te reskonsab yon group esklav.

translation.src_text: Li òganize yo pou yo revòlte.
translation.tgt_text: She encouraged them to revolt.

src_text: Li organize yo pou yo revòlte.

translation.src_text: Yo pran pikèt pou yo pwoteste.
translation.tgt_text: They armed themselves with sticks to protest.

src_text: Yo pran pikèt pou yo proteste.

translation.src_text: Men yo pa te gen chans.
translation.tgt_text: But they were unlucky.

src_text: Men yo pa te gen chance.

translation.src_text: Yo te sènen yo.
translation.tgt_text: They were captured.

src_text: Yo te surround yo.

translation.src_text: Toya te jwenn arestasyon.
translation.tgt_text: Toya was arrested.

src_text: Toya te jwenn arrestation.

translation.src_text: Li te oblije avwe koneksyon li ak lòt gwoup revòlte ki te sou zòd Desalin.
translation.tgt_text: She had to confess her links with other rebel slave groups under the leadership of Dessa­ lines.

src_text: Li te oblije avwe koneksyon li ak lòt rebel groups ki te sou zòd Desalin.

translation.src_text: Madan Lamatinyè se te yon esklav fanm trè popilè nan gwo goumen ki te genyen pou batay lendepandans la.
translation.tgt_text: Madame Marie-Jeanne Lamartinière was an extremely popular slave in the native army which fought for independence.

src_text: Madan Lamatinyè se te yon esklav fanm trè popilè nan gwo goumen ki te genyen pou batay lendepandans la.

translation.src_text: Li te ale nan batay Lakrètapyewo. Tout moun ki te dekouraje yo, lè yo te wè Jàn, yo te gentan jwenn fòs ak kouraj anba kalite pawòl lespwa li t ap klewonnen yo.
translation.tgt_text: She stood out at the Crête à Pierrot, where all those who were discou­ raged, seeing her and hearing her fiery words be­ came more seasoned and fuller of ardor.

src_text: Li te ale nan batay Lakrètapyewo. Tout moun ki te dekouraje yo, lè yo te wè Jàn, yo te gentan jwenn fòs ak kouraj anba kalite pawòl hope li t ap klewonnen yo.

translation.src_text: Se konsa esklav yo te wè manmzèl kon yon fanm dife, yon flanm dife ki fè san yo tout bouyi.
translation.tgt_text: The soldiers saw her as this ember which warms their hearts and their blood with its flames.

src_text: Se konsa esklav yo te wè manmzèl kon yon fanm dife, yon flanm dife ki fè san yo tout boil.

translation.src_text: Sòlda yo te kwè nan Jàn, kou yon fanm beni, kou yon moun ki pote chans.
translation.tgt_text: They believed in Marie-Jeanne, as in a blessed woman, as in a carrier of luck.

src_text: Sòlda yo te kwè nan Jàn, kou yon fanm beni, kou yon moun ki pote luck.

translation.src_text: Jàn se te kòm amilèt yo!
translation.tgt_text: Marie-Jeanne was, for them, like an amulet!

src_text: Jàn se te kòm amulet yo!

translation.src_text: Descourtilz, yon ekriven ki te la, di
translation.tgt_text: Descourtilz, a writer and doctor who was in the fort, said:

src_text: Descourtilz, yon writer ki te la, di

translation.src_text: « vwa sa a fè sòlda yo vin pi fò toujou, li limen nanm yo tankou yon tizon dife. Sòlda vin pi mechan ».
translation.tgt_text: "This voice made the soldiers stronger; it kindled their souls like a fire which made them more determined."

src_text: « vwa sa a fè sòlda yo vin pi fò toujou, li limen nanm yo tankou yon tizon fire. Sòlda vin pi mechan ».

translation.src_text: Panfil Delakwa, yon lòt ekriven di konsa :
translation.tgt_text: Another writer, Panfil De Lacroix, declared:

src_text: Panfil Delakwa, yon lòt writer di konsa :

translation.src_text: « Anba gwo kout kanon ki t ap tonbe sou fò a, alòske lavi a te difisil andedan fò a, Mari-Jàn te kanpe nan tout prestans li, fizi li nan men li, ap tire, ap bay ankourajman, ap bay ekzanp.
translation.tgt_text: "Despite the cannonballs which fell in the fort, and the difficult life, Marie-Jeanne stood in all her splendor, her rifle in her hand. Encouraged, she set the example, she responded to the enemy with her shots.

src_text: « Anba gwo kout kanon ki t ap tonbe sou fò a, alòske lavi a te difisil andedan fò a, Mari-Jàn te kanpe nan tout prestans li, fizi li nan men li, ap tire, ap bay ankourajman, ap bay example.

translation.src_text: Si Lamatinyè, mèch dife nan men l t ap riposte pou fè boulèt tonbe sou lenmi asayan,
translation.tgt_text: If Lamartinière, wick in hand, reta­liated with her cannon balls sent on the assaulting enemy;

src_text: Si Lamatinyè, mèch dife nan men l t ap riposte pou fè boulèt tonbe sou lenmi asayan,

translation.src_text: Marijàn Lamatinyè, anplis kout fizi, li t ap fanatize sòlda endijèn yo pou yo ta pito mouri andedan dekonm fò a pase yo ta remèt lèzam.»
translation.tgt_text: Marie-Jeanne, she fanaticized the native army by shouting:

src_text: "Marijàn Lamatinyè, anplis kout fizi, li t ap fanatize sòlda endijèn yo pou yo ta pito mouri andedan dekonm fò a pase yo ta remèt lèzam.»"

translation.src_text: Katrin Flon Dapre pi fò moun, men sa ki te pase:
translation.tgt_text: “it is better to perish buried in the rubble of a fort than being in the hand of our enemies”.

src_text: Katrin Flon Dapre pi fò moun, men sa ki te happen:

translation.src_text: Depi 14 me rive 18 me 1803, gwo chèf lame nèg yo, ki t ap goumen pou sòti anba lesklavaj, te riyini nan bouk Akayè, pou tabli plan batay pou jou k ap vini yo.
translation.tgt_text: Catherine Flon According to the majority of researchers, here is what really happened: From May 14 to 18, 1803, the ingenious army leaders who were struggling to get out of slavery gathered in Arcahaie to prepare the battle plan for the days to come.

src_text: Depi 14 me rive 18 me 1803, gwo chèf lame nèg yo, ki t ap goumen pou sòti anba lesklavaj, te riyini nan bouk Akayè, pou tabli battle plan pou jou k ap vini yo.

translation.src_text: gwo reyinyon sa a, se li yo rele Kongrè Akayè a.
translation.tgt_text: This meeting was called The Arcahaie Congress.

src_text: gwo reyinyon sa a, se li yo rele Kongrè Akayè a.

translation.src_text: Nan menm kongrè sa a, jou ki te 18 me a, Katrin Flon te koud drapo ble-wouj sa a, se drapo ble-wouj sa a ki te alatèt tout lame nèg y jouk yo rive nan lendepandans.
translation.tgt_text: During this same congress, on May 18, Catherine Flon sewed the blue-red flag.

src_text: Nan menm kongrè sa a, jou ki te 18 me a, Katrin Flon te koud drapo ble-wouj sa a, se drapo ble-wouj sa a ki te alatèt tout lame nèg y jouk yo rive nan independence.

translation.src_text: Nan tan sa a, li te reprezante tèt ansanm nèg ak milat.
translation.tgt_text: It was under this flag that the Negro army fought until independence.

src_text: Nan tan sa a, li te reprezante tèt ansanm nèg ak milat.

translation.src_text: Katrin Flon, yon fanm zansèt Yo toujou asosye Katrin Flon ak kreyasyon drapo a jan nou wè sa.
translation.tgt_text: At that time, it represented the union of blacks and mulattoes.

src_text: Katrin Flon, yon fanm zansèt Yo toujou asosye Katrin Flon ak kreyasyon drapo a jan nou wè sa.

translation.src_text: Epi, dapre sa pi fò moun rapòte, li te fè sa jou 18 me a nan Kongrè Akayè a.
translation.tgt_text: Catherine Flon, a woman of history As we have noticed, Catherine Flon has always been associated with the creation of the flag.

src_text: Epi, dapre sa pi fò moun rapòte, li te fè sa jou 18 me a nan Kongrè Akayè a.

translation.src_text: Alòs, kit se Tirivyè Latibonit, kit se Akayè, non Katrin Flon fè pati listwa, kòm fanm ki te patisipe nan fondasyon nouvo peyi a.
translation.tgt_text: Then, according to what is reported, she did so on May 18 during the Arcahaie Congress.

src_text: Alòs, kit se Tirivyè Latibonit, kit se Akayè, non Katrin Flon fè pati listwa, kòm fanm ki te patisipe nan fondasyon nouvo peyi a.

translation.src_text: Grann Giton 18 me 1803, nan yon ti lokalite tou pre bouk Akayè ki rele Mewòt,
translation.tgt_text: So, whether in Petite Rivière de l'Artibonite, whether in Arcahaie, the name of Catherine Flon is part of history as a woman who participated in the foundation of the new country.

src_text: Grann Giton 18 me 1803, nan yon ti lokalite tou pre bouk Akayè ki rele Mewòt,

translation.src_text: se la jeneral Jan Jak Desalin ansanm avèk lòt chèf ki te ak li yo te kreye drapo peyi a, pandan yo t ap òganize yon kongrè.
translation.tgt_text: Grann Giton May 18, 1803, in a small town near the village of Arcahaie, called Merotte, General Jean Jacques Dessalines and other chiefs who accompanied him, reated the national flag during a congress.

src_text: se la jeneral Jan Jak Desalin ansanm avèk lòt chèf ki te ak li yo te kreye drapo peyi a, pandan yo t ap organize yon kongrè.

translation.src_text: Rezon ki fè se nan Mewòt drapo peyi a te rive kreye, se paske jal Desalin te bon zanmi yon fanm nan Mewòt ki te rele Grann Gitonn.
translation.tgt_text: The reason the flag was created in Merotte is be­ cause in this place Dessalines had a wife named Grann Giton.

src_text: "Rezon ki fè se nan Mewòt drapo peyi a te rive kreye, se paske jal Desalin te bon zanmi yon fanm nan Mewòt ki te rele Grann Gitonn."

translation.src_text: Se kay fanm sa a, Desalin te pran desizyon an.
translation.tgt_text: It was with in this woman’s house that the decision to create a flag was made.

src_text: Se kay fanm sa a, Desalin te pran the decision an.

translation.src_text: Kòm nan epòk sa a pa t gen koutiryè nan Mewòt,
translation.tgt_text: At that time, there was no seamstress in Merotte,

src_text: Kòm nan epòk sa a pa t gen koutiryè nan Mewòt,

translation.src_text: jal la te voye de moso twal yo bay Katrin Flon ki te rete nan Pòtay Koujòl, pou l te kapab koud drapo a pou li.
translation.tgt_text: so the general sent two pieces of fabric to Catherine Flon, so that she could sew the flag. Catherine Flon lived in Portail Courjolle.

src_text: Jal la te voye de moso twal yo bay Katrin Flon ki te rete nan Pòtay Koujòl, pou l te kapab koud the flag a pou li.

translation.src_text: Jounen jodiya, si yon moun rive nan lakou Grann Gitonn nan, l ap wè yon kay, fanmi li apèn rebati.
translation.tgt_text: Today, if you visit Grann Giton yard , you will find a newly rebuilt house.

src_text: Jounen jodiya, si yon moun rive nan lakou Grann Gitonn nan, l ap wè yon kay, fanmi li apèn rebuilt.

translation.src_text: Ertha Pascal fèt Petyonvil yon 13 out.
translation.tgt_text: Ertha Pascal was born in Pétionville on August 13.

src_text: Ertha Pascal fèt Petyonvil yon 13 August.

translation.src_text: Se te 9èm timoun anvan dènye pitit yon fanmi 10 pitit.
translation.tgt_text: She was the penultimate of a family of ten children.

src_text: Se te 9èm timoun anvan dènye pitit yon fanmi 10 pitit.

translation.src_text: Moun ki te konnen li di se te yon adolesan pezib, trankil, ki te renmen solitid.
translation.tgt_text: People who knew her said that Ertha was a calm and quiet teenager who liked soli­ tude.

src_text: Moun ki te konnen li di se te yon adolesan calm, trankil, ki te renmen solitid.

translation.src_text: Alòske papa li te mouri lè li gen 3 zan, li te rete avèk espwa pou li jwenn papa li.
translation.tgt_text: Although her father died when she was only three years old, she dreamed and still hoped to find him.

src_text: Alòske papa li te mouri lè li gen 3 zan, li te rete avèk hope pou li jwenn papa li.

translation.src_text: Li te gen pasyon li liv.
translation.tgt_text: She was passionate about reading.

src_text: Li te gen pasyon li pou liv.

translation.src_text: Li te renmen timoun nan katye li e li te konn patisipe nan jwèt marèl, sote kòd, oslè, pwen kadino.
translation.tgt_text: She loved the children in her neighborhood and used to play with them, either hopscotch, osselets, car­ dinal points, or jump rope.

src_text: Li te renmen timoun nan katye li e li te konn patisipe nan jwèt marèl, sote kòd, oslè, ak pwen kadino.

translation.src_text: Li te renmen mizik ak pwezi.
translation.tgt_text: She also loved music and poetry.

src_text: Li te renmen music ak pwezi.

translation.src_text: Li te renmen resite, powèm ayisyen kou powèm franse.
translation.tgt_text: She loved to recite Haitian poems as well as French poems.

src_text: Li te renmen resite, poems ayisyen kou powèm franse.

translation.src_text: Li te gen yon memwa ekstrawòdinè.
translation.tgt_text: She had an extraordinary memory.

src_text: Li te gen yon extraordinary memwa.

translation.src_text: Ertha te konn ede manman li nan travay lakay, men sa pa te anpeche li kenbe tèt klas li nan segondè tankou nan inivèsite.
translation.tgt_text: Ertha used to help her mother with the housework, but that didn't stop her from maintaining her good grades in high school and col­ lege.

src_text: Ertha te konn ede manman li nan travay lakay, men sa pa te anpeche li kenbe tèt klas li nan high school tankou nan inivèsite.

translation.src_text: Ertha Pascal Ertha te frekante lekòl primè Petyonvil nan lekòl «Sœur Anne Marie Javoueh » ak lekòl «République du Chili ».
translation.tgt_text: Ertha attended the Pétion­ ville primary school, first at the Sister Anne-Marie Javoueh school and then at the Republic of Chile school.

src_text: Ertha Pascal Ertha te frekante lekòl primè Petyonvil nan lekòl «Sœur Anne Marie Javoueh » ak school «République du Chili ».

translation.src_text: Li te debite etid segondè lekòl « Fernand Prosper ».
translation.tgt_text: She started her secondary school at Fernand Prosper College.

src_text: Li te debite etid segondè lekòl « Fernand Prosper ».

translation.src_text: Li te fini nan kolèj «Roger Anglade ».
translation.tgt_text: She completed it at Roger An­ glade College.

src_text: Li te fini nan college «Roger Anglade ».

translation.src_text: Li fè etid dwa li Gonayiv nan lane 1971. Li remèt memwa sòti li epi li defann li devan yon komite.
translation.tgt_text: After that, she studied law in Go­ naïves in 1971, where she completed her thesis, which was successfully presented before a com­mittee.

src_text: Li fè etid dwa li Gonayiv nan lane 1971. Li remèt memwa sòti li epi li defann li devan yon komite.

translation.src_text: Se te premye fanm ki te avoka, premye fanm ki te manm bawo Pòtoprens, premye fanm Jij nan peyi Dayiti, premye fanm nan Kou Kasasyon, premye fanm Prezidan peyi nou.
translation.tgt_text: She became the first female lawyer mem­ ber of the Port-au-Prince bar, the first woman judge in Haiti, the first female at the Court of Cas­ sation, the first female president of Haiti.

src_text: Se te premye fanm ki te avoka, premye fanm ki te manm bawo Pòtoprens, premye fanm Jij nan peyi Dayiti, premye fanm nan Kou Kasasyon, premye fanm President peyi nou.

translation.src_text: Nan lane 1973, Ertha te marye avèk Ernst Trouillot yon gran avoka, ekriven, jounalis. Li gen yon pitit fi.
translation.tgt_text: In 1973, Ertha married Ernst Trouillot, a great lawyer, writer, journalist, and a daughter was born through this union.

src_text: Nan lane 1973, Ertha te marye avèk Ernst Trouillot yon gran avoka, writer, jounalis. Li gen yon pitit fi.

translation.src_text: Nan lane 1972 Madan Ertha Pascal Trouillot te pibliye avèk mari li yon liv enpòtan « Codes de lois usuelles ».
translation.tgt_text: In 1972, Ertha Pascal Trouillot and her hus­ band published the" Codes de Lois usuelles," an important piece of legal work that most lawyers referred to in our Haitians' court system.

src_text: Nan lane 1972 Madan Ertha Pascal Trouillot te pibliye avèk mari li yon liv important « Codes de lois usuelles ».

translation.src_text: Nan lane 1990 li soti tòm II «Codes de lois usuelles» Madan Trouillot te ekri lòt liv ankò, pou pi piti 4 liv.  Ertha Pascal Trouillot te prezidan nou 13 mas 1990.
translation.tgt_text: In 1990, she published another book, Volume II, "Usual Law Codes." By the time she became President of Haiti on March 13, 1990, she had published four books.

src_text: Nan lane 1990 li soti tòm II «Codes de lois usuelles» Madan Trouillot te ekri lòt books ankò, pou pi piti 4 liv. Ertha Pascal Trouillot te prezidan nou 13 mas 1990.

translation.src_text: Li te remèt mayèt la jou ki te 7 fevriye 1991.
translation.tgt_text: On February 7, 1991, she transferred the President's power to Jean Bertrand Aristide with a lot of dignity.

src_text: Li te remèt mayèt la on February 7, 1991.

translation.src_text: Se te jeneral Herard Abraham ki te bay Ertha Pascal envestiti;
translation.tgt_text: General Hérard Abraham gave the investiture to Ertha Pascal;

src_text: Se te jeneral Herard Abraham ki te bay Ertha Pascal investiture;

translation.src_text: 21 kout kanon, woulman tanbou te vin salye Prezidan Ertha ki ta pral gouvène yon peyi malad.
translation.tgt_text: 21 cannon shots and drum rolls came to greet President Ertha, who would lead a volatile country.

src_text: "21 kout kanon, woulman tanbou te vin salye Prezidan Ertha ki ta pral gouvène yon peyi malad."

translation.src_text: Se pa te fasil ditou, men li reyisi fè eleksyon onèt, demokratik, kredib, bagay Ayiti pa te gen depi lontan.
translation.tgt_text: It was not easy, but Ertha succee­ded in having honest elections, democratic, cre­ dible values that Haiti did not have long ago.

src_text: Se pa te fasil ditou, men li reyisi fè eleksyon honest, demokratik, kredib, bagay Ayiti pa te gen depi lontan.

translation.src_text: Jounen jodiya ansyen Prezidan Ertha Pascal ap viv lakay li, nan katye Kriswa, kote l ap ekri liv, l ap prepare konferans, l ap bay sè ak frè legliz li konsèy pou yo byen viv lafwa yo.
translation.tgt_text: Former President Ertha Pascal now lives at her residential home, writing books, presenting lec­ tures, and advising her sisters and brothers to live their faith.

src_text: Jounen jodiya ansyen Prezidan Ertha Pascal ap viv lakay li, nan katye Kriswa, kote l ap ekri liv, l ap prepare konferans, l ap bay sè ak frè legliz li **advice** pou yo byen viv lafwa yo.

translation.src_text: Se konsa n ap fini avèk bèl konsèy sa a, Prezidan Ertha te sere pou nou:
translation.tgt_text: We want to close with this judicious advice offered to us by President Ertha Pascale Trouillot.

src_text: Se konsa n ap fini avèk bèl konsèy sa a, Prezidan Ertha te saved pou nou:

translation.src_text: «Wout la difisil epi mòn nan wo anpil.
translation.tgt_text: She reminds us that the road is difficult and the mountain high.

src_text: «Wout la difisil epi mòn nan wo anpil.

translation.src_text: Men bèl flè santi bon an ki pouse anlè nèt la, li p ap janm pou moun sa yo ki dekouraje, ki rete nan ren mòn nan ap vale van.»
translation.tgt_text: The fragrant flowers that grow at the top will never belong to those discouraged and shelter from the wind at the bottom of the mountain.

src_text: Men bèl flè santi bon an ki pouse anlè nèt la, li p ap janm pou moun sa yo ki dekouraje, ki rete nan ren mòn nan ap vale the wind.»

translation.src_text: Fòk de klòch sonnen pou konn verite-a.
translation.tgt_text: [You must hear] two bells ring to learn the truth.

src_text: Fòk de klòch sonnen pou konn the truth.

translation.src_text: Fòk gen maladi pou gen lanmò.
translation.tgt_text: There must be illness so as to have death.

src_text: Fòk gen maladi pou gen death.

translation.src_text: Fòk ou bat tanbou-a pou tande son li.
translation.tgt_text: You must beat the drum to hear its sound.

src_text: Fòk ou bat tanbou-a pou tande sound li.

translation.src_text: Fòk ou pèdi tan pou ou gen tan.
translation.tgt_text: You need to lose time in order to have time.

src_text: Fòk ou pèdi time pou ou gen tan.

translation.src_text: Grangou se mizè, vant plen se traka.
translation.tgt_text: Hunger is misery; a full stomach is worriness.

src_text: Grangou se mizè, vant plen se trouble.

translation.src_text: Ipokrit se kouto de bò.
translation.tgt_text: Hypocrites are two-edge knifes.

src_text: Ipokrit se yon **double-edged sword**.

translation.src_text: Jan chat mache, se pa konsa li kenbe rat.
translation.tgt_text: The way the cat walks is not the way it holds the rat.

src_text: Jan chat mache, se pa konsa li kenbe rat.

translation.src_text: Jan ou bat tanbou, se konsa nou danse.
translation.tgt_text: The way you beat the drum is how we dance.

src_text: Jan ou bat tanbou, se konsa nou danse.

translation.src_text: Jan ou vini se jan an yo resevwa ou.
translation.tgt_text: The way you come is the way people will receive you.

src_text: Jan ou vini se jan an yo receive ou.

translation.src_text: Je wè, bouch be.
translation.tgt_text: The eyes see, the mouth is silent.

src_text: Je wè, bouch be.

translation.src_text: Jijman Bondye vini sou bourik.
translation.tgt_text: God’s judgment comes on a donkey.

src_text: Jijman Bondye vini sou donkey.

translation.src_text: Joumou pa donnen kalbas.
translation.tgt_text: A pumpkin does not bear gourds.

src_text: Joumou pa donnen kalbas.

translation.src_text: Jwe ak makak, men pa manyen ke-l.
translation.tgt_text: [You may] play with the monkey, but don’t play with its tail.

src_text: Jwe ak makak, men pa manyen its tail.

translation.src_text: Kalbas gran bouch pa kenbe dlo.
translation.tgt_text: A large pot without cover does not hold water.

src_text: Kalbas gran bouch pa kenbe water.

translation.src_text: Kat je kontre, manti kaba.
translation.tgt_text: face to face we meet, no lies.

src_text: Kat je kontre, manti over.

translation.src_text: Kay piti, ou prann nat ou anba bra ou.
translation.tgt_text: [When] the house is small, you hold your bedding under your arm.

src_text: Kay piti, ou prann nat ou anba bra ou.

translation.src_text: Kay koule tronpe soley men li pa tronpe lapli.
translation.tgt_text: A leaking roof may fool sunny weather, but cannot fool the rain.

src_text: Kay koule **trick** soley men li pa **trick** lapli.

translation.src_text: Kòfrefò pa swiv kòbiya.
translation.tgt_text: The safe does not follow the hearse.

src_text: Kòfrefò pa swiv kòbiya.

translation.src_text: Komansman chante se soufle.
translation.tgt_text: The first steps of singing are breath.

src_text: Komansman chante se breath.

translation.src_text: Konmisyon pa chaj.
translation.tgt_text: An errand is not a load.

src_text: Konmisyon pa charge.

translation.src_text: Kote fil fini, se la kouti fini.
translation.tgt_text: Where the thread ends is where the seam ends.

src_text: Kote fil fini, se la kouti fini.

translation.src_text: Kote ki gen grangou, kabrit pa mouri nan kòd.
translation.tgt_text: Where there is hunger, goats do not die tied to their ropes.

src_text: Kote ki gen grangou, kabrit pa mouri nan rope.

translation.src_text: Kote ki gen granmoun, kay pa boule.
translation.tgt_text: Where there are elders, the house do not burn.

src_text: Kote ki gen granmoun, kay pa burn.

translation.src_text: Kote ki gen kou pa gen chenn, kote ki gen chenn nanpwen kou.
translation.tgt_text: Where there are blows, there are no chains; where there are chains, there are no blows.

src_text: Kote ki gen kou pa gen chenn, kote ki gen chenn nanpwen pain.

translation.src_text: Kote y’ap plimen kòdenn, poul pa ri.
translation.tgt_text: Where they pluck turkeys, chickens do not laugh.

src_text: Kote y’ap plimen kòdenn, poul pa laugh.

translation.src_text: Koulèv ki vle gwo rete nan trou-l.
translation.tgt_text: The snake that wants to get big stays in its hole.

src_text: Koulèv ki vle gwo rete nan hole-l.

translation.src_text: Kouto pa janm grate manch li.
translation.tgt_text: A knife never scrubs its own handle.

src_text: Kouto pa janm grate handle li.

translation.src_text: Krapo fè kòlè, li mouri san dèyè.
translation.tgt_text: A toad gets angry, it dies without its buttock.

src_text: Krapo fè kòlè, li mouri san **back**.

translation.src_text: Labou rete kouran.
translation.tgt_text: The mud stops the flow.

src_text: Labou rete current.

translation.src_text: Lajan kase wòch.
translation.tgt_text: Money breaks rocks.

src_text: Lajan kase rock.

translation.src_text: Lamepriz vo mye ke larepons.
translation.tgt_text: Contempt is better than an answer.

src_text: Lamepriz vo mye ke the response.

translation.src_text: Lane pase toujou pi bon.
translation.tgt_text: ‘Last year’ is always better.

src_text: Lane pase toujou pi bon.

translation.src_text: Lang pa lanmè, men li ka neye-w.
translation.tgt_text: The tongue is not the sea, but it can drown you.

src_text: Lang pa lanmè, men li ka drown-w.

translation.src_text: Lè kabrit gen twòp mèt, li mouri nan solèy.
translation.tgt_text: When a goat has too many masters (owners), it dies (tied) in the sun.

src_text: Lè kabrit gen twòp mèt, li mouri nan sun.

translation.src_text: Lè labouyi cho, ou manje-l a rebò.
translation.tgt_text: When the porridge is hot, you eat it on the side.

src_text: Lè labouyi cho, ou manje-l a edge.

translation.src_text: Lè pyebwa jwe ak van, li pèdi fèy li.
translation.tgt_text: When the tree plays with the wind, it loses its leaves.

src_text: Lè pyebwa jwe ak van, li pèdi leaves li.

translation.src_text: Lè setan ou echi (lè ou fin’ fè tan ou), se ale p’ou ale.
translation.tgt_text: When your seven years are over (when your time is done), you [must] go for good.

src_text: Lè setan ou echi (lè ou fin’ fè tan ou), se ale p’ou ale.

translation.src_text: Lè w’ap neye, ou kenbe branch ou jwenn.
translation.tgt_text: When you are drowning, you hang to the branch you reach.

src_text: Lè w’ap neye, ou kenbe branch ou jwenn.

translation.src_text: Lè yon chodyè cho, ou pa desann li ak men.
translation.tgt_text: When a pot is hot, you do not take it down with your hands.

src_text: Lè yon chodyè cho, ou pa desann li ak hands.

translation.src_text: Lespwa fè viv.
translation.tgt_text: Hope makes one live.

src_text: Lespwa fè nou live.

translation.src_text: M’pat manje pwa, m’pa ka poupou pwa.
translation.tgt_text: I did not eat beans, I cannot poop beans.

src_text: M’pat manje pwa, m’pa ka poop pwa.

translation.src_text: Machann nan mache gen de mezi.
translation.tgt_text: The merchant at the market has two measures.

src_text: Machann nan mache gen de measures.

translation.src_text: Mache dousman, ou pòte bon nouvèl.
translation.tgt_text: Walk slowly [when] you bear good news.

src_text: Mache dousman, ou pote good nouvèl.

translation.src_text: Madichon ou bay bèlmè ou se manman ou li rive.
translation.tgt_text: When you curse your stepmother, your mother will be the victim.

src_text: Madichon ou bay bèlmè ou se manman ou li happened.

translation.src_text: Maladi pa konn vanyan.
translation.tgt_text: Illness does not know brave heart.

src_text: Maladi pa konn strong.

translation.src_text: Malè avèti pa touye kokobe.
translation.tgt_text: A foreseen disaster does not kill the fool.

src_text: Malè avèti pa touye the kokobe.

translation.src_text: Malè pa gen klaksonn.
translation.tgt_text: Misfortune has no horn.

src_text: Malè pa gen horn.

translation.src_text: Vye nèg pa vye chen.
translation.tgt_text: An old man is not an old dog.

src_text: Vye nèg pa vye dog.

translation.src_text: Manje kwit pa gen mèt.
translation.tgt_text: Cooked food has no master.

src_text: Manje kwit pa gen owner.

translation.src_text: Mapou tonbe, kabrit manje fèy li.
translation.tgt_text: When the ‘Mapou’ [huge tree] is down, the goats eat its leaves.

src_text: Mapou tonbe, kabrit manje leaves li.

translation.src_text: Marengwen mòde-w sou nen, men ou pa ka ba-l kou fò.
translation.tgt_text: The mosquito bites you on the nose, but you cannot hit it hard.

src_text: Marengwen mòde-w sou nen, men ou pa ka ba-l yon hard kou.

translation.src_text: Memwa se paswa.
translation.tgt_text: Memory is a strainer.

src_text: Memwa se past.

translation.src_text: Menm nan lanfè gen mounpa.
translation.tgt_text: Even in hell, there are people from your clan.

src_text: Menm nan lanfè gen people.

translation.src_text: Mennen koulèv al lekòl pa anyen; se fè-l chita ki rèd.
translation.tgt_text: To take the snake to school is nothing; it is to make it sit that is tough.

src_text: Mennen koulèv al lekòl pa anyen; se fè-l chita ki hard.

translation.src_text: Mèt do pa grate do.
translation.tgt_text: You cannot scratch your own back.

src_text: Mèt do pa grate back.

translation.src_text: Mezire avan ou koupe.
translation.tgt_text: Measure before you cut.

src_text: Mezire avan ou cut.

translation.src_text: Mouch pa bezwen vyann, men li gate-l.
translation.tgt_text: The fly does not need the meat, but it will spoil it.

src_text: Mouch pa bezwen vyann, men li gate it.

translation.src_text: Moun ki bezwen deyò chache chemen pòt.
translation.tgt_text: He who must go out search for the door.

src_text: Moun ki bezwen deyò chache chemen door.

translation.src_text: Moun mouri pa konnen valè dra blan.
translation.tgt_text: The dead does not know the value of white sheets.

src_text: Moun mouri pa konnen valè white dra blan.

translation.src_text: Moun mouri pa pè santi.
translation.tgt_text: The dead is not afraid to smell.

src_text: Moun mouri pa pè feel.

translation.src_text: Moun pa konn achte chat nan sak.
translation.tgt_text: People don’t buy a cat in a bag.

src_text: Moun pa konn achte chat nan bag.

translation.src_text: Moun pa-w se dra.
translation.tgt_text: Your clan is sheets.

src_text: Moun pa-w se sheet.

translation.src_text: Move zèb ka leve toupatou.
translation.tgt_text: Weeds can grow anywhere.

src_text: Move zèb ka grow toupatou.

translation.src_text: Nan bay kout men, ou jwenn kout pye
translation.tgt_text: You give a hand, but [you may] get kicked out.

src_text: Nan bay kout men, ou jwenn kout pye

translation.src_text: Nan mitan diri, ti wòch goute grès.
translation.tgt_text: In the middle of [cooked] rice, a little pebble will taste grease.

src_text: Nan mitan diri, ti wòch goute greasy.

translation.src_text: Nan mitan avèg, bògn se rwa.
translation.tgt_text: Among the blind, the one-eyed is king.

src_text: Nan mitan avèg, bògn se king.

translation.src_text: Nanpwen cho ki pa vin frèt..
translation.tgt_text: There is nothing hot that will not get cold.

src_text: Nanpwen cho ki pa vin cold..

translation.src_text: Nanpwen metye ki pa nouri mèt li..
translation.tgt_text: There is no craft that will not feed the craftsman.

src_text: Nanpwen metye ki pa nouri its mèt li..

translation.src_text: Nèg fè lide-l, Bondye ba-l dwa.
translation.tgt_text: The man gets the idea, God authorizes it.

src_text: Nèg fè lide-l, Bondye ba-l right.

translation.src_text: Nen pran kou, je kouri dlo; je pran kou, nen kouri dlo.
translation.tgt_text: The nose is hurt, the eyes water; the eyes are hurt, the nose runs.

src_text: Nen pran kou, je kouri dlo; je pran kou, nen kouri dlo.

translation.src_text: Nou léd, nou la.
translation.tgt_text: We are ugly, but we are here.

src_text: Nou léd, nou here.

translation.src_text: Ou bat tanbou epi ou danse ankò.
translation.tgt_text: You beat the drum and you dance again.

src_text: Ou bat tanbou epi ou danse again.

translation.src_text: Ou granmoun sèlman lè ou lakay ou.
translation.tgt_text: You are an old man only when you are at home.

src_text: Ou granmoun sèlman lè ou home.

translation.src_text: Ou konn kouri, men fòk ou konn kache.
translation.tgt_text: You [may] know how to run, but you must know how to hide.

src_text: Ou konn kouri, men fòk ou konn hide.

translation.src_text: Ou konn sa w’ap kite; ou pa konn sa ou pral jwenn.
translation.tgt_text: You [may] know what you leave behind; you do not know what you will get.

src_text: Ou konn sa w’ap kite; ou pa konn sa ou pral get.

translation.src_text: Ou pa fouye zo nan kalalou.
translation.tgt_text: You do not dig up bones in akra.

src_text: Ou pa fouye zo nan kalalou.

translation.src_text: Ou pa dwè dekouvri Sen Pòl pou kouvri Sen Piè.
translation.tgt_text: You must not undress Saint Paul to dress Saint Peter.

src_text: Ou pa dwè dekouvri Sen Pòl pou cover Sen Piè.

translation.src_text: Ou pa ka fè san sòti nan wòch.
translation.tgt_text: You cannot have blood flow from a rock.

src_text: Ou pa ka fè san soti nan rock.

translation.src_text: Ougan pa janm geri maleng li.
translation.tgt_text: The ‘ougan’ (Medecine Man) never cures his own illness.

src_text: Ougan pa janm geri maleng li.

translation.src_text: Ouvriye vann zouti-l, men li pa vann metye-l.
translation.tgt_text: A carpenter [may] sell his tools, but he [cannot] sell his skills.

src_text: Ouvriye vann zouti-l, men li pa vann skill-l.

translation.src_text: Pa bay bèf la babokèt lè l’ap rale kabwèt.
translation.tgt_text: Do not put the harness on the ox when it is going to pull the kart.

src_text: Pa bay bèf la babokèt lè l’ap pull kabwèt.

translation.src_text: Pa jete vye chodyè pou chodyè nèf.
translation.tgt_text: Don’t throw away the old pot for a new pot.

src_text: Pa jete vye chodyè pou nouvo pots.

translation.src_text: Pa kroke makout twò wo, men kote men ou ka rive.
translation.tgt_text: Do not hang the basket too high, but where your hand can reach it.

src_text: Pa kroke makout twò wo, men kote men ou can rive.

translation.src_text: Pa pale sa ou pa we ak prop je ou.
translation.tgt_text: Never talk about something that you have not seen with your own eyes.

src_text: Pa pale sa ou pa see ak prop je ou.

translation.src_text: Pa pèdi founo pou yon sèl pen.
translation.tgt_text: Do not lose your oven over just one bread.

src_text: Pa pèdi founo pou yon sèl bread.

translation.src_text: Padon pa geri maleng.
translation.tgt_text: Forgiveness does not cure illness.

src_text: Padon pa geri wounds.

translation.src_text: Pale franse pa di lespri pou sa.
translation.tgt_text: To speak French does not mean wits.

src_text: Pale franse pa di lespri pou that.

translation.src_text: Parese pa gen kay.
translation.tgt_text: Lazy people do not have a house.

src_text: Parese pa gen home.

translation.src_text: Paròl gen zèl.
translation.tgt_text: Words have wings.

src_text: Paròl gen wings.

translation.src_text: Parol pa chay.
translation.tgt_text: Words are not a load.

src_text: Parol pa burden.

translation.src_text: Paròl two fò, machwè gonfle.
translation.tgt_text: Too false words [make] the jaw swell.

src_text: Paròl two loud, machwè gonfle.

translation.src_text: Pè pa preche de fwa.
translation.tgt_text: Fear does not preach twice.

src_text: Pè pa preche twice.

translation.src_text: Pitit ki pa kriye pa bezwen tete.
translation.tgt_text: The baby who does not cry does not need to be breast-fed.

src_text: Pitit ki pa crye pa bezwen tete.

translation.src_text: Pitit tig, se tig.
translation.tgt_text: A tiger cub is a tiger.

src_text: Pitit tig, se tiger.

translation.src_text: Pito ou mize ou nan wout, ou pote bon nouvèl.
translation.tgt_text: Better to take your time on the way, if you bring good news.

src_text: Pito ou mize ou nan wout, ou pote bon news.

translation.src_text: Pòt tè pa goumen ak pòt fè.
translation.tgt_text: The clay pot [must] not wrestle with the iron pot.

src_text: Pòt tè pa goumen ak pòt fè.

translation.src_text: Pousyè pa leve san van.
translation.tgt_text: Dust does not lift without wind.

src_text: Pousyè pa leve san wind.

translation.src_text: Premye so pa so.
translation.tgt_text: The first fall is not a fall

src_text: Premye so pa jump.

translation.src_text: Pye pa gen rasinn : tout moun ka tonbe.
translation.tgt_text: Feet have no roots: everyone can fall.

src_text: Pye pa gen roots : tout moun ka tonbe.

translation.src_text: Pye poul pi bon pase bwadann.
translation.tgt_text: A hen’s foot is better than a donkey’s hoof.

src_text: Pye poul pi bon pase wood.

translation.src_text: Gwo non touye ti chen
translation.tgt_text: Too much fame can be bad.

src_text: Gwo non kill ti chen

translation.src_text: Rad pa janm fè moun.
translation.tgt_text: Clothes do not make a person.

src_text: Rad pa janm fè people.

translation.src_text: Rad sal lave nan fanmi.
translation.tgt_text: Dirty clothes are [to be] washed in the family.

src_text: Rad sal lave nan family.

translation.src_text: Rann sèvis mennen chagren.
translation.tgt_text: To give a hand leads to sorrow.

src_text: Rann sèvis mennen sorrow.

translation.src_text: Rat anpil, trou pa fon.
translation.tgt_text: Lots of rats, the hole is not deep.

src_text: Rat anpil, trou pa deep.

translation.src_text: Rat konnen chat konnen barik mayi-a rete la.
translation.tgt_text: The rat knows, the cat knows: the corn barrel is safe.

src_text: Rat konnen chat konnen barik mayi-a rete there.

translation.src_text: Rat mode, souffle
translation.tgt_text: Rats bite then blow.

src_text: Rat mode, breathe

translation.src_text: Rayi chen an, men di dan li blanch.
translation.tgt_text: [You may] hate the dog, but [you must] admit that its teeth are white.

src_text: Rayi chen an, men di dan li white.

translation.src_text: Rebwè se nòs.
translation.tgt_text: Drinking again is [like] a wedding.

src_text: Rebwè se a toast.

translation.src_text: Regle jis pa gate zanmi.
translation.tgt_text: A fair deal does not spoil friendship.

src_text: Regle jis pa gate friends.

translation.src_text: Responsab se chay.
translation.tgt_text: [To be] responsible is a load.

src_text: Responsab se a burden.

translation.src_text: Sa je pa wè, kè pa tounen.
translation.tgt_text: What you don’t know can’t hurt you.

src_text: Sa je pa wè, kè pa tounen.

translation.src_text: Sa ki rete nan kè-m dòmi lakay.
translation.tgt_text: What is still in my heart sleeps at my home.

src_text: Sa ki rete nan kè-m dòmi at home.

translation.src_text: Sa ou pa konnen pi gran pase ou.
translation.tgt_text: What you do not know is bigger than you.

src_text: Sa ou pa know pi gran pase ou.

translation.src_text: Sa ou t’ap chache antè, ou jwenn li atè.
translation.tgt_text: What you are searching underground, you find it on the ground.

src_text: Sa ou t’ap chache antè, ou jwenn li on the ground.

translation.src_text: Sa-k pase nan kizin, lakay pa bezwen konnen.
translation.tgt_text: What goes on in the kitchen, the house does not need to know.

src_text: Sa-k pase nan kizin, lakay pa bezwen know.

translation.src_text: Sak vid pa kanpe.
translation.tgt_text: An empty sack cannot stand up.

src_text: Sak vid pa stand.

translation.src_text: Se aprè batay nou konte blese.
translation.tgt_text: It is after the battle that you count the injured.

src_text: Se aprè batay nou konte injuries.

translation.src_text: Se chat kay k’ap manje poul kay.
translation.tgt_text: It is the cat of the house that will eat the hen of the house.

src_text: Se chat kay k’ap manje poul kay.

translation.src_text: Se de bon ki fè bonbon.
translation.tgt_text: It’s two ‘good’ that makes candy.

src_text: Se de bon ki fè bonbon.

translation.src_text: Se grès kochon an ki kwit kochon an.
translation.tgt_text: It is the pork’s grease that cooks the pork.

src_text: Se grès kochon an ki kwit kochon an.

translation.src_text: Se kouto sèlman ki konnen sa ki nan kè yanm.
translation.tgt_text: Only the knife knows what is in the yam’s heart.

src_text: Se kouto sèlman ki konnen sa ki nan kè yam.

translation.src_text: Se lakizin ki di-m ki jan lakay ye.
translation.tgt_text: It is the kitchen that tells me how the house is.

src_text: Se lakizin ki di-m ki jan lakay ye.

translation.src_text: Se lè koulèv mouri ou wè longè-l.
translation.tgt_text: It is when the snake dies that you can see its size.

src_text: Se lè koulèv mouri ou wè longè-l.

translation.src_text: Sè lè van soufle ou wè dèyè poul.
translation.tgt_text: It is when the wind blows that you can see the hen’s behind.

src_text: Sè lè van soufle ou wè behind poul.

translation.src_text: Se mèt kò ki veye kò.
translation.tgt_text: It is the owner of the body who watches his body.

src_text: Se mèt kò ki veye kò.

translation.src_text: Se nan chemen ou konnen sa-k pase nan chanm.
translation.tgt_text: It is on the road that you learn what goes on in [your] room.

src_text: Se nan chemen ou konnen sa-k pase nan room.

translation.src_text: Se nan chemiz blanch yo wè tach
translation.tgt_text: It is on the white shirt that one can see the stain.

src_text: Se nan chemiz blanch yo wè stains

translation.src_text: Se pa nèg ki voye wòch ki te tiye koulèv-la, se nèg ki te wè’l
translation.tgt_text: It is not the man who threw the stone who killed the snake: it is the man who saw it.

src_text: Se pa nèg ki voye wòch ki te tiye koulèv-la, se nèg ki te wè’l

translation.src_text: Se siro ki rale foumi.
translation.tgt_text: It is the syrup that attract ants.

src_text: Se siro ki rale ants.

translation.src_text: Se sou pye mango chaje yo voye wòch.
translation.tgt_text: It is on the mango tree full of fruits that they throw stones.

src_text: Se sou pye mango chaje yo voye stones.

translation.src_text: Se soulye ki konn si chosèt gen twou.
translation.tgt_text: It is the shoe that knows if the sock has a hole.

src_text: Se soulye ki konn si chosèt gen holes.

translation.src_text: Si bòt la tro jis pou ou, mache pye atè.
translation.tgt_text: If your boot is too tight, walk barefoot.

src_text: Si bòt la tro tight pou ou, mache pye atè.

translation.src_text: Si m’te konnen toujou dèyè.
translation.tgt_text: ‘If I had known’ is always behind.

src_text: Si m’te konnen toujou behind.
